cost_models.MNQ: MNQ: 1 tick spread (0.25 pt = $0.50, half per side), 1 tick slippage per market order or stop, $1.50 commission + $0.50 exchange/NFA fees per side; about $5.50 per round turn.
cost_models.NQ: NQ: 1 tick spread (0.25 pt = $5, half per side), 1 tick slippage per market order or stop, $1.50 commission + $1.40 exchange/NFA fees per side; about $20.80 per round turn.
cost_models.BTC: BTC: Coinbase 0.60% taker on entries, stops and time exits, 0.40% maker on targets, $1 spread and $2 slippage per side (per coin).
cost_models.ETH: ETH: Coinbase 0.60% taker on entries, stops and time exits, 0.40% maker on targets, $0.10 spread and $0.10 slippage per side (per coin).

strategies.name: EMA 20 pullback
strategies.rules: Long: 20 EMA above the 50 EMA and rising; the bar touches the 20 EMA and closes above it on an up bar. Short: mirror. Stop 1 tick beyond the two-bar extreme.

strategies.name: VWAP reversion
strategies.rules: Session VWAP from 18:00 New York. Long: a close below VWAP minus 2 standard deviations, then a close back inside on an up bar. Short: mirror. Stop 1 tick beyond the two-bar extreme. Target: VWAP.

strategies.name: Liquidity sweep and reclaim
strategies.rules: Long: the bar trades below the last confirmed swing low, closes back above it and above the prior bar high. Short: mirror at the last swing high. Stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme.

strategies.name: Opening range breakout
strategies.rules: Range: high and low of 9:30–9:45 New York. Entry: the first 5-minute close above the high (long) or below the low (short) between 9:45 and 11:30. Stop: the middle of the range. Target: the R multiple of the portfolio. Flat by 15:55 New York.

strategies.name: Trend breakout and retest
strategies.rules: Breakout: within the last 10 bars, a close above the high of the 20 bars before it (long) or below their low (short), with no close back inside since. Entry: a later bar trades back to the broken level (within 0.25 ATR) and closes beyond it in the breakout direction; market order at the next open. Stop: 1 tick beyond the retest bar. Target: the R multiple of the portfolio.

strategies.name: Momentum continuation
strategies.rules: Long: 20 EMA above the 50 EMA and rising; the previous bar is an up displacement (body at least 1.5 ATR, close in the top quarter of its range); this bar closes above the displacement high. Short: mirror. Stop: 1 tick beyond the displacement bar's far end. Target: the R multiple of the portfolio.

strategies.name: Range rejection
strategies.rules: Range: the 20-bar efficiency ratio is 0.25 or less (choppy). Long: the bar trades into the bottom 10% of the prior 20-bar range and closes up, in the upper half of its own range, below the range midpoint. Short: mirror at the top. Stop: 1 tick beyond the bar or the range edge, whichever is further. Target: the range midpoint.

strategies.name: Volatility contraction and expansion
strategies.rules: Contraction: the previous bar's Bollinger(20, 2σ) band width is in the narrowest 10% of its last 100 values. Expansion: this bar closes outside the band with a true range of at least 1.2 ATR; above is long, below is short. Stop: the band middle (20-bar average). Target: the R multiple of the portfolio.
